title: Enforcement health v1
description: GET /healthz payload. Carries a capability field per primitive so degradation is observable before the first enforcement (spec: degrade per primitive, not whole).

kernel_faked.description: Present (non-empty) while the daemon runs on the faked kernel — CI and dev. An empty string means a real kernel loader. Exists so a faked kernel can never be mistaken for enforcement.

reason.description: Why the primitive is unavailable; omitted when supported.
